invented.quote: The new attorney will carry a full caseload of about 80 tenants a year
invented.why: The brief states that each attorney carries about 80 open cases at a time, not that an attorney only handles 80 cases per year.

invented.quote: Over the two-year grant, that means about 160 more households will have a lawyer in eviction court.
invented.why: This two-year total of 160 households is calculated from the invented claim that an attorney's caseload of 80 open cases equals 80 cases per year.
